Method of Attack: Insecure deserialization leading to arbitrary code execution
Exploitation of the Constructor class to deserialize malicious YAML files
Use of gadget classes or gadget chains to execute commands
Impacted Systems: Applications with third-party libraries containing exploitable gadgets
Systems using Spring Boot or Helidon frameworks
Attack Vector: Malicious YAML files provided to the Yaml.load() method
Exploitation of classes in the JDK (e.g., ScriptEngine, JdbcRowSetImpl)
Indicators of Compromise: YAML input such as !!com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl with LDAP requests
